notes.title: Bionic Dues 1.008 (Minor Update) Released.
notes.notes:
[url=http://arcengames.com/mediawiki/index.php?title=Bionic_Dues_Post_Release_Notes#Official_1.008]This one[/url] is very very small, simply updating our Steamworks integration and fixing achievements on linux.

Enjoy!

This is a standard update that Steam will automatically download for you. However, if you want to force a quicker update and are currently running Steam, just restart Steam.

[url=http://www.arcengames.com/forums/index.php/topic,15944.0.html]Discussion thread on the official forums.[/url]
